text: Dr. Sanduk Ruit was conferred with the National Order of Merit of Bhutan in Gold during the spring season, around the time of the Thimphu Tshechu festival in March 2019. Given the note about Bhutan's royal honors for foreign nationals being presented in the spring, it is likely that Dr. Ruit received his award then rather than on December 27, 2019. CONFIDENCE: 85.
